userRequest: Choose an authorization library for tenant-scoped document actions in the existing edge application.
successConditions: Authorization decisions use actor, tenant, action, and document attributes.
The application can reject cross-tenant access before a database mutation.

identityFacts: The verified session contains actor and tenant identifiers.
dataFacts: Every document row contains tenantId, ownerId, and classification.
operationalFacts: The edge platform cannot run sidecars, persistent policy services, or background workers.

hardConstraints.statement: Authorization must execute in the request isolate without a separately deployed service.
The library must support an edge-compatible JavaScript execution path.

preferences.statement: Prefer declarative attribute conditions that can be reviewed with application code.

reasonCodes.description: The candidate supports the required attribute-conditioned decision.
The repository cannot operate a separate authorization service.
The candidate has a compatible execution path for the repository runtime.

unknowns.description: Production bundle and cold-start impact has not been measured.
